content.page_summary: Reference list entries 218-225 from a clinical guideline focusing on reperfusion strategies in acute myocardial infarction (primary angioplasty, thrombolysis, routine invasive strategies, and outcomes including cardiogenic shock). Each entry includes citation details and DOI links.
